# load behavior data
```{r}
all_trials_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, "all_trials_brains.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
all_trials_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$missed == 0, ]

indiv_df = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "participant_check.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)  %>%
  mutate(age_bi = case_when(age <= 36 ~ "younger",
                            age > 36 ~ "older"))

all_trials_df = merge(all_trials_df, indiv_df, by.x = "subjID", by.y = "participant_id")

L3_47_df = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "participant_L3_47.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)

sublist_final = L3_47_df %>% dplyr::select(subjID)

all_trials_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$subjID %in% sublist_final$subjID,] 

all_trials_df = all_trials_df %>% 
  mutate(ingroup = relevel(as.factor(ingroup), ref = "0"),
         human = relevel(as.factor(human), ref = "0"),
         age_bi = relevel(as.factor(age_bi), ref = "younger"),
         block_fair = relevel(as.factor(block_fair), ref = "0"),
         accept = relevel(as.factor(accept), ref = "0"),
         offer_3 = offer-3) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, offer, accept, human, ingroup, block_fair, age_bi, missed)

all_trials_human_df = all_trials_df[all_trials_df$human == 1,]

```

# norm
## human only
```{r}
## ingroup offer norm
ingroup_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_human_df$ingroup == 1,]
ingroup_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer|subjID), 
                 data = ingroup_df, 
                 family = binomial)
summary(ingroup_mlm)

# ingroup_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_human_df$ingroup == 1,]
# ingroup_mlm_2 = glmer(accept ~ offer_3 + (1+offer||subjID), 
#                  data = ingroup_df, 
#                  family = binomial)
# summary(ingroup_mlm_2)
# anova(ingroup_mlm_1, ingroup_mlm_2, refit = F)

## extract random intercept and slope
ingroup_random_intercept <- ranef(ingroup_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(ingroup_randIntercept = condval,
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, ingroup_randIntercept)

ingroup_random_slope <- ranef(ingroup_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  filter(term == "offer") %>%
  mutate(ingroup_randSlope = condval,
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, ingroup_randSlope)

## extract fixed intgercept and slope
ingroup_fixed_effects <- fixef(ingroup_mlm) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "fixed")

ingroup_fixedIntercept = ingroup_fixed_effects$.[ingroup_fixed_effects$fixed == "(Intercept)"]

ingroup_fixedSlope = ingroup_fixed_effects$.[ingroup_fixed_effects$fixed == "offer"]

## outgroup offer norm
outgroup_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_human_df$ingroup == 0,]
outgroup_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer + (1+offer|subjID), 
                    data = outgroup_df, 
                    family = binomial)
summary(outgroup_mlm)

outgroup_random_intercept <- ranef(outgroup_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(outgroup_randIntercept = condval,
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, outgroup_randIntercept)

outgroup_random_slope <- ranef(outgroup_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%  filter(term == "offer") %>%
  mutate(outgroup_randSlope = condval,
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, outgroup_randSlope)

outgroup_fixed_effects <- fixef(outgroup_mlm) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "fixed")

outgroup_fixedIntercept = outgroup_fixed_effects$.[outgroup_fixed_effects$fixed == "(Intercept)"]

outgroup_fixedSlope = outgroup_fixed_effects$.[outgroup_fixed_effects$fixed == "offer"]

## in-out
in_out_norm_full_df = merge(ingroup_random_intercept, outgroup_random_intercept, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(outgroup_randIntercept = outgroup_random_intercept$outgroup_randIntercept,
         ingroup_randSlope = ingroup_random_slope$ingroup_randSlope, 
         outgroup_randSlope = outgroup_random_slope$outgroup_randSlope,
         ingroup_norm = 
           (ingroup_randIntercept + ingroup_fixedIntercept) / (ingroup_randSlope + ingroup_fixedSlope),
         outgroup_norm =
           (outgroup_randIntercept + outgroup_fixedIntercept) / (outgroup_randSlope + outgroup_fixedSlope),
         in_out_logit = ingroup_norm - outgroup_norm)
```

## computer
```{r}
## computer offer norm
computer_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_df$human == 0,]
computer_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer_3 + (1+offer_3|subjID), 
                     data = computer_df, 
                     family = binomial)
summary(computer_mlm)

computer_random_effects <- ranef(computer_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>% 
  mutate(computer = condval,
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, computer)

## human offer norm
human_df = all_trials_human_df[all_trials_df$human == 1,]
human_mlm = glmer(accept ~ offer_3 + (1+offer_3|subjID), 
                     data = human_df, 
                     family = binomial)
# summary(human_mlm)

human_random_effects <- ranef(human_mlm, condVar = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(human = condval,
         subjID = grp) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, human)

## soc-nonsoc
soc_nonsoc_rand_df = merge(computer_random_effects, human_random_effects, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(soc_nonsoc_logit = human - computer,
         soc_nonsoc_prob = (exp(human) / (1 + exp(human))) - exp(computer) / (1 + exp(computer))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subjID, soc_nonsoc_logit, soc_nonsoc_prob)
```

# logit
## in_out_norm_df for L3 w/ cov
```{r}
in_out_norm_df = in_out_norm_full_df %>% merge(., L3_47_df, by = "subjID") %>% 
  mutate(in_out_demean = in_out_logit - mean(in_out_logit),
         in_out_young = in_out_demean*younger,
         in_out_old = in_out_demean*older,
         ones = 1)
write.csv(in_out_norm_df, paste(data_dir, "in_out_norm_full_logit.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)

in_out_norm_df = in_out_norm_full_df %>% 
  select(subjID, ones, ismale, tsnr, fd_mean, RT, 
         younger, older,
         in_out_young, in_out_old)
write.csv(in_out_norm_df, paste(data_dir, "L3_cov_in_out_norm_full_logit.csv", sep = "/"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
